name: gif-maker
title: GIF Maker
description: Convert videos to GIFs with control over size, frame rate, trimming, and compression. Powered by ffmpeg.
author: tristan_gabl

commands.name: create-gif
commands.title: Create GIF
commands.description: Convert a video to a GIF with control over size, frame rate, and trimming

commands.name: quick-gif
commands.title: Quick GIF from Finder
commands.description: Convert the video selected in Finder to a GIF using your default settings

preferences.name: defaultSize
preferences.title: Quick GIF Size
preferences.description: Longest side of the output, used by Quick GIF from Finder

preferences.name: defaultFps
preferences.title: Quick GIF Frame Rate
preferences.description: Frame rate used by Quick GIF from Finder

preferences.name: defaultOptimize
preferences.title: Quick GIF Compression
preferences.description: gifsicle post-processing used by Quick GIF from Finder. Ignored if gifsicle is not installed.

preferences.name: defaultDenoise
preferences.title: Defaults
preferences.label: Reduce grain
preferences.description: Whether grain reduction is on by default. Helps on camera footage, not on screen recordings.

preferences.name: defaultLoop
preferences.label: Loop forever
preferences.description: Whether new GIFs loop by default

preferences.name: defaultReveal
preferences.label: Reveal in Finder when done
preferences.description: Whether to open Finder with the new GIF selected

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Path
preferences.description: Optional. Leave blank to auto-detect Homebrew and system locations.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
